title: Largest low spot (mock)
body: Water collects here during heavy rain.
why_it_matters: Low spots stay wet longer and can flood crops.
tip: Ask a local agronomist whether a drainage check is worthwhile.

title: Main drainage line (mock)
body: Runoff from most of the field drains along this valley.
why_it_matters: Concentrated flow can carry soil away.
tip: Consider a grassed waterway here. Verify locally.

title: Persistent bare patch (mock)
body: This patch looks bare in the imagery.
why_it_matters: Bare soil erodes faster in heavy rain.
tip: Consider whether this patch could carry a cover crop.

title: Texture alignment assumed (mock)
body: The photo is stretched to the selected rectangle.
why_it_matters: Cover classes near the edges may be slightly off.
tip: Check edges against what you know of the field.
